title: Inspect file-table reader 80001DF4

target.name: func_80001DF4_29F4
target.manifest_ownership: assembly_functions in file_table.c; no accepted C definition

behavior.input_width: The function uses all 32 bits of a0 for the zero test and left-shift-by-3 table offset; there is no low-16-bit mask. Two of three observed callers explicitly pass their source index masked to 16 bits; the adjacent file-table caller passes its incoming a0 unchanged.

table_reference.extent_or_element_type: Not established by the pinned per-unit assembly labels; do not infer table length from the synthetic test allocation.

gate_helper.name: func_80001E50_2A50
gate_helper.use: Called before the zero-index check. Exact result 0x11 returns flag 0x40000000; otherwise index zero returns zero, and a nonzero index reads the table.

behavior.mask_and_return: Returns 0 or 0x40000000 from the loaded word mask (bit 30); it does not return a boolean 1. Caller sites use the result as a zero/nonzero condition.
behavior.abi: 0x18-byte frame; saves ra at sp+0x14; stores incoming a0 to the outgoing argument home at sp+0x18 in the helper jal delay slot; restores ra before return.

caller_sites.argument: halfword from D_80168150 masked with 0xFFFF before call

comparison_with_sibling.name: func_80001D68_2968
comparison_with_sibling.behavior: Masks input to low 16 bits, uses a 4-byte stride into D_800573D4_57FD4, clears bit 31 with 0x7FFFFFFF, and returns the remaining word. It is not semantically interchangeable with 80001DF4.

plan_correction: The prior G64-071 wording incorrectly referred to bit 31 for 80001DF4. Original ROM evidence shows bit 30 (0x40000000) in 80001DF4; bit 31 is cleared by sibling 80001D68. TASKS_100.json and PHASE_08.md now state the distinction.

candidate_trials.mismatch: First mismatch is branch direction/layout: IDO branches nonzero indices to the table block, while the original branches zero to the return path and falls through to the table lookup.

candidate_trials.hypothesis: Keep the original zero-input branch as a forward zero-result block and table lookup as fallthrough.
candidate_trials.decision: Regressed from the baseline first mismatch and grew by four bytes. Stop under the bounded v2 budget; do not try more source shapes.

toolchain.linker: GNU mips-linux-gnu-ld 2.45.90.20260125; original VMA linker script used SUBALIGN(4)

decision.reason: The ROM-backed behavioral contract and host cases are complete. Both native candidates remain nonmatching; the alternate branch-layout hypothesis regressed. Retain GLOBAL_ASM.
